name: Smoke: base+PR58+PR44
command: cd /tmp && echo "=== extended binary sha256 check ===" && curl -sSL -o sbx.tar.gz "https://github.com/shtorm-7/sing-box-extended/releases/download/v1.13.14-extended-2.5.3/sing-box-1.13.14-extended-2.5.3-linux-amd64-musl.tar.gz" && sha256sum sbx.tar.gz && tar -tzf sbx.tar.gz | head -4 && echo "=== merge-bases ===" && git -C /home/dark/netshift merge-base gh-main pr-58 && git -C /home/dark/netshift merge-base gh-main pr-44 && for wt in ns-base ns-m58 ns-m44; do cd /tmp/$wt; echo "=== $wt: build ==="; docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans 2>/dev/null; docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml build 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "=== $wt: run all ==="; docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml run --rm netshift-test all > /tmp/smoke-$wt.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -20 /tmp/smoke-$wt.log; docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans 2>/dev/null; done; echo "=== shellcheck m58 ==="; docker run --rm -v /tmp/ns-m58:/mnt --entrypoint sh koalaman/shellcheck:stable -c 'shellcheck -S error -s sh /mnt/install.sh /mnt/netshift/files/usr/bin/netshift /mnt/netshift/files/usr/lib/*.sh' && echo "SHELLCHECK CLEAN ns-m58" || echo "SHELLCHECK ISSUES ns-m58"; echo "=== shellcheck m44 ==="; docker run --rm -v /tmp/ns-m44:/mnt --entrypoint sh koalaman/shellcheck:stable -c 'shellcheck -S error -s sh /mnt/install.sh /mnt/netshift/files/usr/bin/netshift /mnt/netshift/files/usr/lib/*.sh' && echo "SHELLCHECK CLEAN ns-m44" || echo "SHELLCHECK ISSUES ns-m44"; echo ALL_DONE
